Name: Better Panning Rewards - Dynamic Daily Bonuses
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Better Panning Rewards - Dynamic Daily Bonuses
[/b][/size]
[i]Transform panning into a rewarding daily activity with escalating bonuses throughout the week![/i][/center]

[quote]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[size=3][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][size=3]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/size][/url][/quote]

[size=5][b]Overview
[/b][/size]
Tired of getting the same meager rewards from panning? This mod completely overhauls the panning system with a dynamic weekly cycle that provides increasingly valuable bonuses each day. From basic materials on Monday to guaranteed rare gems and massive ore yields on Sunday - every day of the week offers unique and exciting rewards!

[center]﻿
[b][color=#ffff00]For Demo Purpose, The number of ore is maximized, and chance for treasure.
[/color][/b][/center][center]﻿[youtube]92L9hpYg5Jk[/youtube][/center]
[quote]For HUD indicator: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39924]Panning Spot Indicator - HUD Hint With Optional Simple Loot
[/url][/quote]
[size=5][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Weekly Progression System[/b] - Each day of the week has unique reward tiers
[/list][list]
[*][b]Escalating Rewards[/b] - Start with basic materials and build up to iridium ore and prismatic shards
[/list][list]
[*][b]Works with All Pan Types[/b] - Copper Pan, Gold Pan, and Iridium Pan all supported
[/list][list]
[*][b]Fully Configurable[/b] - Customize ore amounts, bonus items, and chances for each day via Generic Mod Config Menu
[/list][list]
[*][b]Balanced Progression[/b] - Designed to feel rewarding without breaking game balance
[/list][list]
[*][b]No Conflicts[/b] - Works alongside vanilla panning system - adds bonuses on top of normal rewards
[/list]

[center][color=#ffff00][b]For Demo Purpose, The number of ore is maximized, and chance for treasure.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Every aspect is customizable through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]:
[list]
[*]Adjust ore quantities for each day (0-50)
[*]Enable/disable bonus items per day
[*]Set Prismatic Shard spawn chance (0-100%)
[*]Toggle the entire mod on/off
[*]Enable debug logging to see rewards in console
[/list]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (3.14.0 or later)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, for easy configuration)
[/list]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[*]Run the game through SMAPI
[*]Optional: Install Generic Mod Config Menu to customize settings in-game
[/list]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with all pan upgrades (Copper, Gold, Iridium)
[*]Compatible with vanilla game and most other mods
[*]Uses Harmony patching for maximum compatibility
[*]Multiplayer compatible (each player gets their own bonuses)
[/list]

[size=5][b]FAQ[/b][/size]
[b]Q: Does this work with modded pans?[/b]
A: Yes, as long as they inherit from the base Pan class.

[b]Q: Can I adjust the rewards to be more/less generous?[/b]
A: Absolutely! Every value is configurable through GMCM.

[b]Q: Does this replace vanilla panning rewards?[/b]
A: No, it adds bonus items on top of the normal vanilla rewards.

[b]Q: Will this work in multiplayer?[/b]
A: Yes, each player will receive the configured bonuses when they pan.

[size=5][b]Console Commands[/b][/size]
[code]panning_spawn[/code] - Spawns a panning spot near the player for testing
